key_points: Board approved ~1% North America store closures (~250 stores) with ~$300M restructuring charge.
JPMorgan lowered price target, signaling analyst skepticism.
Insider sale by Rep. Kevin Hern adds to negative sentiment.
Starbucks opening a global capability center in Chennai with 800 tech hires to support turnaround.
Store closures aim to improve efficiency but weigh on short-term earnings.
